objectives.drive: Drive Ganaa to the Grand Market — stop on the marker

intro.t: Hey, kid! You're Tömör's little brother, Bat, right? You've got the same face.
That's right. Do you know my brother? He's been missing for three months.
Of course — we rented a flat together. The last time I saw him was at the Grand Market.
My taxi's parked right here. You drive me to the market and I'll tell you everything on the way.

ride.t: Tömör was a good guy. Came from the countryside, worked hard, sent money home.
Then last winter he sat down at a card table… and ended up owing Bagsh.
The owner of the market. Half the city owes him money, the other half is afraid of him.
Even the North Hill crew and the East Blocks boys tread carefully around Bagsh.
And mind the traffic lights, kid. The police in this city are always watching.

outro.t: Here we are. Bagsh sits by the market's west gate — the man in the red deel and hat.
Keep the taxi for now. If anything happens, call me — just ask for Ganaa, everyone knows me.

objectives.drive: Deliver the cargo to the East Blocks

intro.t: Ah, Tömör's brother. Did you know your brother owes me thirty million tögrög?
Tell me where my brother is. I'll pay his debt.
Pay? Where would a country boy find that kind of money? You'll pay with work.
There's cargo in my minibus. Get it to the East Blocks within two and a half minutes. Late is the same as never.

call.t: One more thing, boy. Don't open the cargo. Curious people don't live long in this city.

outro.t: Bagsh's guy? Leave the cargo right there.
Tell Bagsh the East Blocks paid their monthly share. And don't send new faces again.
Even the East Blocks pay Bagsh… What did my brother get himself into?

objectives.tail: Tail the black SUV without being noticed
objectives.observe: Watch from a distance — stop and wait

intro.t: Bat? I'm Saraa, a journalist. Ganaa told me about you.
I've been investigating Bagsh's corruption for three years. Your brother was a witness in the case.
A witness? Then where is he?
That's the question. Across the street there's a black SUV from the North Hill gang — they just met with Bagsh.
Take my car. Follow them and find out where they go. Too close and they'll notice; too far and you'll lose them.

call.t: I'm on the phone with you. Don't let that SUV out of your sight.

outro.t: Saraa, they drove into a yard on North Hill. The gate is red.
The red gate… I have a tip that your brother was last seen there.
Don't go in alone. I'll check my sources and call you. Be careful, Bat.
